items.en: We further present two GUI execution demos illustrating complementary ways in which DeepSearch integrates with GUI execution: GUI actions handle the interaction with applications, while DeepSearch handles external knowledge acquisition, comparison, and decision making. In the first demo (Figure 10), the task requires solving a knowledge and reasoning problem before any GUI operation: identifying the knockout-stage match with the largest comeback in the current World Cup. The upper panels trace the multi-round search process, from keyword-based DeepSearch over ranked sources, through targeted web fetches that extract and cross-check match scores, to a search summary that identifies Argentina’s 3–2 comeback after trailing 0–2. DeepSearch thereby converts a vague, cross-source user request into an explicit GUI target before execution begins, so that in the trajectory below the agent opens RedNote, searches for the identified match directly, filters posts from the previous seven days, and opens the most discussed post without blind in-app searching or trial and error. In the second demo (Figure LABEL:fig:deepsearch_to_gui2 in Appendix LABEL:app:examples), DeepSearch is instead invoked on demand in the middle of GUI execution: the agent first locates a Douyin video on evidence-based weight loss and extracts its main claims through GUI actions, then calls DeepSearch to verify these claims against research papers, official guidelines, and authoritative sources, since whether and what to comment cannot be decided from the interface alone. The verification conclusions directly determine the subsequent GUI actions, namely posting a comment that corrects the misleading claims and supplements the necessary caveats, forming a closed observe–research–decide–act loop.
items.zh: 我们进一步展示了两个 GUI 执行演示，以说明 DeepSearch 与 GUI 执行相结合的互补方式：GUI 操作负责与应用程序的交互，而 DeepSearch 负责外部知识获取、比较与决策。在第一个演示（图 10）中，任务要求在做出任何 GUI 操作之前解决一个知识与推理问题：识别当前世界杯中逆转幅度最大的淘汰赛比赛。上方面板描绘了多轮搜索过程，从基于关键字的 DeepSearch 对排序来源的检索，到定向抓取网页以提取并交叉核对比赛比分，再到生成识别出阿根廷在 0-2 落后后以 3-2 逆转的搜索摘要。DeepSearch 由此在执行开始前将模糊的跨来源用户请求转换为明确的 GUI 目标，因此在下方轨迹中，智能体直接打开小红书，搜索已识别的比赛，筛选过去七天的帖子，并打开讨论最多的帖子，而无需在应用内盲目搜索或反复试错。在第二个演示（附录 LABEL:app:examples 中的图 LABEL:fig:deepsearch_to_gui2）中，DeepSearch 则是在 GUI 执行过程中按需调用：智能体首先定位一个关于循证减肥的抖音视频，并通过 GUI 操作提取其主要观点，随后调用 DeepSearch 以研究论文、官方指南和权威来源来验证这些观点，因为是否可以评论以及评论什么无法仅从界面判断。验证结论直接决定后续的 GUI 操作，即发布一条纠正误导性观点并补充必要注意事项的评论，从而形成一个闭环的“观察-研究-决策-行动”循环。

items.en: We evaluate the GUI grounding capabilities of Qwen-UI-Agent across five comprehensive benchmarks: ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot-V2, MMBench-GUI L2, OSWorld-G-Refined, and UI-Vision. These benchmarks cover high-resolution professional software, general cross-platform interfaces, desktop software environments, and instruction-driven grounding.
items.zh: 我们在五个综合性基准上评估 Qwen-UI-Agent 的 GUI 定位能力：ScreenSpot-Pro、ScreenSpot-V2、MMBench-GUI L2、OSWorld-G-Refined 和 UI-Vision。这些基准涵盖高分辨率专业软件、通用跨平台界面、桌面软件环境以及指令驱动的定位任务。

items.en: As shown in Table 8, the 27B variant achieves strong grounding performance across all five benchmarks, reaching 76.6% on ScreenSpot-Pro without zoom-in, 97.5% on ScreenSpot-V2, 92.6% on MMBench-GUI L2, 78.5% on OSWorld-G-Refined, and 70.0% on UI-Vision. On ScreenSpot-Pro, it ranks first among all compared models both without and with zoom-in, and its score further increases to 81.5% with zoom-in. These results demonstrate accurate element localization across both common interfaces and complex professional software, including settings where the target must be inferred from functional or spatial context rather than explicit text.
items.zh: 如表 8 所示，27B 变体在所有五个基准上都表现出强大的定位性能：在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上（不放大）达到 76.6%，在 ScreenSpot-V2 上达到 97.5%，在 MMBench-GUI L2 上达到 92.6%，在 OSWorld-G-Refined 上达到 78.5%，在 UI-Vision 上达到 70.0%。在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上，它在有无放大的情况下均排名所有对比模型第一，且开启放大后分数进一步提高到 81.5%。这些结果表明，无论是在常见界面还是复杂专业软件中，Qwen-UI-Agent 都能实现精准的元素定位，包括需要根据功能或空间上下文而非显式文本推断目标位置的情形。

items.en: The grounding capability also remains strong across model scales. On ScreenSpot-Pro, the 35B-A3B and 4B variants achieve 76.1% and 67.8% without zoom-in, with their scores increasing to 80.2% and 74.0% with zoom-in. The 35B-A3B variant further reaches 96.7% on ScreenSpot-V2, 92.0% on MMBench-GUI L2, 74.6% on OSWorld-G-Refined, and 65.9% on UI-Vision, while activating only 3B parameters per token. The corresponding scores of the 4B variant are 94.9%, 87.9%, 70.5%, and 51.6%. Together, these results show that Qwen-UI-Agent provides reliable GUI grounding across common interfaces, professional software, and instruction types, from compact to moderate model scales.
items.zh: 定位能力在多个模型规模下也保持强劲。在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上，35B-A3B 和 4B 变体在不放大时分别达到 76.1% 和 67.8%，开启放大后分数分别提升至 80.2% 和 74.0%。35B-A3B 变体在 ScreenSpot-V2、MMBench-GUI L2、OSWorld-G-Refined 和 UI-Vision 上分别达到 96.7%、92.0%、74.6% 和 65.9%，而每个 token 仅激活 3B 参数。4B 变体的相应分数为 94.9%、87.9%、70.5% 和 51.6%。这些结果共同表明，从紧凑型到中等规模的模型，Qwen-UI-Agent 都能在常见界面、专业软件和指令类型上提供可靠的 GUI 定位。

items.en: Evaluation note: All results in this table are independently reproduced in our evaluation environment. Scores may differ from official reports because some evaluation settings are not identical. Unless noted below, we follow the corresponding official benchmark protocol.
items.zh: 评测说明：表中所有结果均在我们自己的评测环境中独立复现。由于部分评测设置不完全相同，分数可能与官方报告存在差异。除非下文另有说明，我们均遵循相应的官方基准协议。

items.en: Tau2-Bench. We follow the official leaderboard task set, harness, and scoring protocol, but use GPT-5.5 as the user simulator and judge.
items.zh: Tau2-Bench。我们遵循官方排行榜的任务集、评测框架和评分协议，但使用 GPT-5.5 作为用户模拟器和评判器。

items.en: Terminal-Bench 2.0. Following the Qwen3.6 evaluation setup, we use the Harbor/Terminus-2 harness with a three-hour timeout and up to 32 CPUs and 48 GB of memory per task. We use temperature 1.0, top-\(p\) 0.95, top-\(k\) 20, an 80K-token output limit, and a 256K context window, and report the average over five runs.
items.zh: Terminal-Bench 2.0。我们遵循 Qwen3.6 的评测设置，使用 Harbor/Terminus-2 评测框架，每项任务超时三小时，最多使用 32 个 CPU 和 48 GB 内存。我们设置温度为 1.0，top-\(p\) 为 0.95，top-\(k\) 为 20，输出上限为 80K token，上下文窗口为 256K，并报告五次运行的平均结果。

items.en: Claw-Eval. We follow the official 199-task, three-trial protocol and scoring rule, but use GPT-5.5 for both general and multi-turn judging and Qwen3.6-Plus for multi-turn user simulation, replacing the official Gemini 3 Flash/Claude Opus 4.6 setup. We use a sampling temperature of 0.6.
items.zh: Claw-Eval。我们遵循官方 199 个任务、三次试验的协议和评分规则，但使用 GPT-5.5 进行通用和多轮评判，使用 Qwen3.6-Plus 进行多轮用户模拟，替代官方的 Gemini 3 Flash/Claude Opus 4.6 设置。我们使用 0.6 的采样温度。

items.en: SkillsBench. We follow the Qwen3.6 evaluation setup. We use OpenCode to evaluate 78 self-contained tasks, excluding tasks that depend on external APIs, and report the average over five runs.
items.zh: SkillsBench。我们遵循 Qwen3.6 的评估设置。我们使用 OpenCode 评估 78 个自包含任务，排除依赖外部 API 的任务，并报告五次运行的平均值。

items.en: QwenClawBench. We follow the official v1.1 task set, three-run protocol, and penalized-hybrid scoring, but replace the default Claude Opus 4.5 judge with GPT-5.2. We also pin the OpenClaw runtime to version 2026.6.1 rather than the moving main image.
items.zh: QwenClawBench。我们遵循官方 v1.1 任务集、三轮协议和惩罚混合评分，但将默认的 Claude Opus 4.5 评判模型替换为 GPT-5.2。我们还将 OpenClaw 运行时固定到 2026.6.1 版本，而不是移动的主镜像。

items.en: Qwen-UI-Agent develops strong GUI domain knowledge while retaining the general reasoning and agentic capabilities inherited from its base model. As shown in Table 9, it also substantially outperforms specialized GUI models on general and agentic benchmarks. Together, these results indicate that Qwen-UI-Agent remains a broadly capable model rather than becoming a narrow GUI-only model. This broader capability profile may also help it handle out-of-distribution or unusual tasks that require knowledge, reasoning, and tool use beyond routine GUI interaction.
items.zh: Qwen-UI-Agent 在保留从基础模型继承的通用推理和智能体能力的同时，发展了强大的 GUI 领域知识。如表 9 所示，它在通用和智能体基准测试上也显著优于专门的 GUI 模型。总之，这些结果表明 Qwen-UI-Agent 仍然是一个能力广泛的模型，而不是成为一个狭隘的仅限 GUI 的模型。这种更广泛的能力特征也可能帮助它处理需要超出常规 GUI 交互的知识、推理和工具使用的分布外或异常任务。

items.capEn: Figure 11: Demonstration of proactive service based on mobile notifications. The trajectory is organized into highlighted stages: proactive task initiation from a detected notification, proactive execution phases, and a decision-ready result, with the executed action annotated beneath each key frame

items.en: Beyond benchmark evaluations, we qualitatively examine the workflows enabled by the harness layer introduced in Section 2.5, covering proactive service initiation and cross-platform task execution.
items.zh: 超越基准评测,我们定性考察了第 2.5 节引入的 Harness 层所支撑的工作流,涵盖主动服务启动与跨平台任务执行。

items.en: We present two representative proactive-service trajectories in Figure 11 and Figure LABEL:fig:proactive_demo_b of Appendix LABEL:app:examples. Each trajectory is organized into four highlighted stages: proactive task initiation, one or more proactive execution phases, and a decision-ready result. In Figure 11, a scheduled 08:00 trigger combines the user’s morning commitments, extracted from the highlighted notification, with live weather and commute conditions. The harness first retrieves the weather, then reasons over public-transit and taxi options through map navigation, and delivers an actionable morning brief with umbrella advice, departure timing, and key reminders before the user asks. In Figure LABEL:fig:proactive_demo_b, the harness detects a flight-cancellation notification (highlighted in the first stage) that puts a next-day 14:00 demo at risk. It proactively searches alternative flights and high-speed trains in two execution phases, evaluates which options arrive on time, and presents a decision-ready travel recovery plan, leaving the final booking decision to the user. Both examples show the harness converting passive notifications into contextualized, executable assistance while keeping consequential actions under user control.
items.zh: 我们在图 11 和图 LABEL:fig:proactive_demo_b(见附录 LABEL:app:examples)中展示两条具有代表性的主动服务轨迹。每条轨迹分为四个突出阶段:主动任务启动、一个或多个主动执行阶段,以及可直接决策的结果。在图 11 中,安排在 08:00 的触发器将用户的早晨安排(从高亮通知中提取)与实时天气和通勤状况结合起来。Harness 首先获取天气,然后通过地图导航比较公交和出租车方案,并在用户提问之前输出可执行的晨间简报,包括雨伞建议、出发时间和关键提醒。在图 LABEL:fig:proactive_demo_b 中,Harness 检测到一条航班取消通知(第一阶段高亮),这可能影响次日 14:00 的演示。它主动在两个执行阶段搜索备选航班和高铁,评估哪些选项能准时到达,并提出一份可直接决策的差旅恢复方案,将最终预订决定留给用户。两个示例都显示 Harness 将被动通知转化为情境化、可执行的协助,同时将重要操作保留在用户控制之下。

In this workflow, mobile subtasks run on virtual screens of the physical device, so execution does not block the user’s own actions. full.sec: 4 Behavioral Analysis of GUI Agent Execution
full.secZh: 4 GUI 智能体执行的行为分析

items.en: Aggregate benchmark scores show whether an agent completes a task, but reveal less about how it executes the task, why it fails, and how its behavior changes after RL training. We therefore examine four questions mainly on the execution behavior of Qwen-UI-Agent. (1) Why do models optimized for simulated benchmarks struggle on physical devices? (2) How does Qwen-UI-Agent combine GUI, CLI, and batched actions during task execution, and what distinctive execution patterns emerge from these choices? (3) How does action RL change step-level execution behavior? (4) How does online RL reshape trajectory-level behavior in long-horizon tasks? Together, these analyses complement aggregate metrics by revealing how the agent responds to challenging environments, uses its action space, and changes after RL training.
items.zh: 聚合基准分数能够显示智能体是否完成任务，但较少揭示它如何执行任务、为何失败，以及经过 RL 训练后行为如何变化。因此，我们主要围绕 Qwen-UI-Agent 的执行行为考察四个问题。（1）为什么在模拟基准上优化的模型在物理设备上难以运行？（2）Qwen-UI-Agent 在执行任务时如何组合 GUI、CLI 和批量操作，这些选择又产生了哪些独特的执行模式？（3）动作 RL 如何改变步骤级执行行为？（4）在线 RL 如何重塑长时程任务中的轨迹级行为？综合起来，这些分析通过揭示智能体如何应对挑战性环境、如何使用其动作空间、以及在 RL 训练后如何变化，对聚合指标形成补充。

full.sec: 4.1 How Does a Model’s Limited Real-Device Experience Affect Its Execution Behavior?
full.secZh: 4.1 模型有限的真实设备经验如何影响其执行行为？

items.en: Most models have limited direct exposure to physical-device interaction during training. Frontier models such as Qwen 3.7 Plus perform strongly across a broad range of benchmarks, yet their results on MobileWorld-Real suggest that reliable execution on physical devices remains challenging. This raises a more specific behavioral question: when models have limited real-device interaction during training, which execution patterns emerge, and how do these patterns contribute to task failure? To investigate this question, we review every failed Qwen 3.7 Plus trajectory on MobileWorld-Real and AndroidDaily to identify the primary failure modes.
items.zh: 大多数模型在训练期间对物理设备交互的直接接触有限。前沿模型（如 Qwen 3.7 Plus）在广泛的基准上表现强劲，但它们在 MobileWorld-Real 上的结果表明，在物理设备上可靠执行仍然具有挑战性。这引出了一个更具体的行为问题：当模型在训练期间只有有限的真实设备交互时，会出现哪些执行模式？这些模式又是如何导致任务失败的？为探究这一问题，我们审查了 Qwen 3.7 Plus 在 MobileWorld-Real 和 AndroidDaily 上的每一条失败轨迹，以识别主要失败模式。

items.capEn: Figure 13: Representative real-device failure patterns of Qwen 3.7 Plus. Execution capability limitations: (a) exploration failure, (b) erroneous action loops, (c) lost execution state. Real-world scenario challenges: (d) UI misreading, (e) pop-up interference, (f) physical widget control. Speech bu

items.en: As shown in Table 10, we organize the failures along two dimensions, both rooted in the scarcity of real interaction experience during training: execution capability limitations (40.3%), where simulated environments provide little incentive to learn exploration, error recovery, and state tracking, and real-world scenario challenges (52.0%), triggered by interface phenomena that sanitized simulators rarely contain. As illustrated in Figure 13, we pair two key frames with the model’s abridged thinking for one representative case of each pattern, and analyze each pattern in detail below.
items.zh: 如表 10 所示，我们沿两个维度对失败进行分类，这两个维度都源于训练中真实交互经验的稀缺：执行能力局限（40.3%）——模拟环境几乎无法激励模型学习探索、错误恢复和状态追踪；以及真实世界场景挑战（52.0%）——由经过净化的模拟器很少包含的界面现象触发。如图 13 所示，我们为每种模式的一个代表性案例，将两个关键帧与模型的简略思考过程配对，并在下文逐一分析每种模式。

items.en: Qwen 3.7 Plus’s failures in this dimension (40.3%) reflect limitations in three execution capabilities: locating less commonly used or deeply nested app functions, recovering from unexpected feedback or interface states, and maintaining task state over long trajectories.
items.zh: Qwen 3.7 Plus 在这一维度上的失败（40.3%）反映出三种执行能力的局限：定位不太常用或嵌套较深的应用功能、从意外反馈或界面状态中恢复，以及在长轨迹中维持任务状态。

items.en: Exploration failure (19.5%) occurs when the target is a less commonly used function hidden behind multiple entry points or deep page hierarchies. In these cases, Qwen 3.7 Plus often revisits a small set of shallow pages instead of exploring alternative routes (Figure 13(a)). By contrast, Qwen-UI-Agent examines multiple plausible entries before committing to a path.
items.zh: 探索失败（19.5%）发生在目标功能不太常用、且被多个入口或深层页面层级所掩盖时。在这些情况下，Qwen 3.7 Plus 往往会重访少量浅层页面，而不是探索替代路径（图 13(a)）。相比之下，Qwen-UI-Agent 会在确定路径之前检查多个合理入口。

items.en: Erroneous action loops (14.3%) stem from the long tail of real third-party applications, where an action frequently fails to produce the expected transition. Handling such expectation violations is itself a learned skill that simulators, with their highly predictable interaction outcomes, offer few opportunities to acquire. When an action fails to produce the intended result, we find that models with limited exposure to physical-device interaction during training tend to repeat the same action or alternate between two interface states rather than diagnose the failure and revise their plan (Figure 13(b)).
items.zh: 错误动作循环（14.3%）源于真实第三方应用的长尾分布，在这些应用中，某个动作常常无法产生预期的状态转换。处理这种预期违背本身是一种习得技能，而模拟器的交互结果高度可预测，几乎不提供习得该技能的机会。当一个动作未能产生预期结果时，我们发现，在训练期间接触真实设备交互有限的模型倾向于重复同一动作或在两个界面状态之间切换，而不是诊断失败原因并调整计划（图 13(b)）。

items.en: Lost execution state (6.5%) appears in long-horizon tasks that require intermediate information and completed progress to be retained across app switching, interruptions, and multiple subtasks. In these trajectories, Qwen 3.7 Plus may lose track of prior progress and repeat completed subtasks or restart part of the workflow from scratch (Figure 13(c)).
items.zh: 丢失执行状态（6.5%）出现在需要跨应用切换、中断和多个子任务保留中间信息与已完成进度的长周期任务中。在这些轨迹中，Qwen 3.7 Plus 可能会丢失先前进度，重复已完成子任务，或从头重新开始部分工作流（图 13(c)）。

items.en: Failures in this dimension (52.0%) involve interface conditions that are common on physical devices but may be less frequently represented during training: ambiguous page semantics, unexpected interface disruptions, and interactive widgets requiring fine-grained manipulation.
items.zh: 该维度上的失败（52.0%）涉及物理设备上常见但在训练中可能较少出现的界面条件：模糊的页面语义、意外的界面中断，以及需要精细操作的交互式小部件。

items.en: UI misreading (24.7%) arises because real pages carry stateful semantics that pure visual appearance does not disambiguate, such as pre-filled search terms, placeholder hints, and dynamically refreshed lists, whereas simulator interfaces stay clean and static. Models trained in simulated environments consequently misjudge the interface state, most typically mistaking a grey placeholder for user-entered text and repeatedly attempting to clear it instead of typing over it (Figure 13(d)).
items.zh: UI 误读（24.7%）的产生是因为真实页面带有纯视觉外观无法区分的状态化语义，例如预填的搜索词、占位符提示和动态刷新的列表，而模拟器界面保持干净且静态。因此，在模拟环境中训练的模型会误判界面状态，最典型的是将灰色占位符误认为用户输入的文本，并反复尝试清除它，而不是直接覆盖输入（图 13(d)）。

items.en: Pop-up interference (18.2%) covers advertisements, paywalls, CAPTCHAs, and unresponsive or blank pages, non-deterministic disruptions that simulators exclude by design to keep evaluation reproducible. Lacking any recovery prior, these models either follow the disruption away from the original task or keep retrying the blocked path (Figure 13(e)).
items.zh: 弹窗干扰（18.2%）涵盖广告、付费墙、验证码以及无响应或空白页面，这些非确定性干扰是模拟器为保持评估可复现而刻意排除的。由于缺乏恢复先验，这些模型要么跟随干扰偏离原始任务，要么不断重试被阻塞的路径（图 13(e)）。

items.en: Physical widget control (9.1%) concerns scroll wheels, sliders, and date pickers that demand incremental closed-loop manipulation, where the agent must observe the current value and adjust the swipe magnitude accordingly. In simulated environments such values are typically set by direct text injection or single taps, so the agent applies fixed-magnitude swipes that overshoot the target in both directions and never converge (Figure 13(f)).
items.zh: 物理控件操作（9.1%）涉及滚动轮、滑块和日期选择器，它们需要增量的闭环操作，智能体必须观察当前值并相应调整滑动幅度。在模拟环境中，这些值通常通过直接文本注入或单击设置，因此智能体使用固定幅度的滑动，导致在两个方向上均超调目标且始终无法收敛（图 13(f)）。

items.en: The findings above motivate the real-device training and evaluation infrastructure described in Section 2.2.2 and help explain Qwen-UI-Agent's strong performance on real-world mobile devices.
items.zh: 上述发现为第 2.2.2 节所述的真机训练与评估基础设施提供了动机，并有助于解释 Qwen-UI-Agent 在真实移动设备上的强劲表现。

full.sec: 4.2 A Closer Look at GUI–CLI Coordination and Batched Execution in Qwen-UI-Agent
full.secZh: 4.2 细看 Qwen-UI-Agent 的 GUI–CLI 协调与批量执行

items.en: Qwen-UI-Agent executes computer-use tasks through trajectories that interleave GUI and CLI actions, while selectively emitting multiple actions together in batched form. This hybrid execution process raises two questions: how does the model divide operations between GUI and CLI, and when does it choose to batch multiple actions? We analyze trajectories generated by Qwen-UI-Agent on OSWorld-Verified and OSWorld-v2 and present the resulting behavioral patterns below.
items.zh: Qwen-UI-Agent 通过交错执行 GUI 与 CLI 动作的轨迹来完成计算机使用任务，同时会以批量形式选择性地一次性发出多个动作。这种混合执行过程引出了两个问题：模型如何在 GUI 与 CLI 之间划分操作？以及它何时选择批量执行多个动作？我们分析了 Qwen-UI-Agent 在 OSWorld-Verified 和 OSWorld-v2 上生成的轨迹，并在下文中展示由此产生的行为模式。

items.en: Beyond aggregate usage statistics, we examine recurring patterns in the trajectories to understand how Qwen-UI-Agent uses GUI interaction, CLI execution, and batched actions in practice. The examples below identify typical scenarios for each capability and illustrate how they complement one another during task execution, although they represent empirical tendencies rather than fixed capability boundaries.
items.zh: 除了总体的使用统计之外，我们还检查了轨迹中的重复模式，以理解 Qwen-UI-Agent 在实践中如何使用 GUI 交互、CLI 执行和批量操作。下面的示例指出了每种能力的典型场景，并说明它们在任务执行过程中如何相互补充，尽管这些场景代表的是经验性倾向，而非固定的能力边界。

items.en: **GUI Interaction.** Qwen-UI-Agent tends to rely on GUI interaction when the interface serves as both the control surface and the source of execution feedback, particularly for operations involving native application controls, visual navigation, or spatial manipulation. Figure 14 shows six recurring cases: filling spreadsheet cells with structured headings, formulas, and repeated values, using in-page search to locate a relevant passage, scrolling through a long interface until the required content becomes visible, manipulating media through native timeline controls, interacting with a spatial object whose state is defined by geometry, and zooming in to make fine-grained visual evidence legible before acting. These examples show that GUI interaction supports not only interface navigation but also operations whose execution and subsequent decisions depend on visible state transitions, native application controls, or continuous spatial feedback.
items.zh: **GUI 交互。** Qwen-UI-Agent 在界面既是控制面又是执行反馈来源时倾向于依赖 GUI 交互，特别是涉及原生应用控件、视觉导航或空间操作的任务。图 14 显示了六个反复出现的场景：用结构化标题、公式和重复值填充电子表格单元格；使用页内搜索定位相关段落；滚动长界面直到所需内容可见；通过原生时间线控件操作媒体；与状态由几何定义的空间对象交互；以及在操作前放大以看清细粒度的视觉证据。这些示例表明，GUI 交互不仅支持界面导航，还支持那些执行和后续决策依赖于可见状态转换、原生应用控件或连续空间反馈的操作。

(a) a compact GUI macro for in-page search, (b) a 21-action dependent form sequence that stops at the next uncertain dialog, and (c) a GUI–CLI handoff that verifies a spatial manipulation through structured task state. items.en: **CLI Execution.** Qwen-UI-Agent tends to use CLI when information or operations can be represented more compactly and precisely as data or code than as a sequence of GUI interactions. Figure 15 shows six recurring uses: retrieving relevant documents from a mixed corpus, parsing machine-readable records, organizing multiple images into a labeled contact sheet, transforming artifacts programmatically, executing repeated grading computations, and verifying output properties such as dimensions, brightness, and process state. Together, these patterns show CLI functioning as a search-space reducer before reasoning, an efficient execution channel for structured operations, and a precise postcondition verifier after editing. The contact-sheet example further illustrates that CLI can complement visual reasoning by reorganizing dispersed visual evidence into a single comparison surface rather than replacing the visual judgment itself.
items.zh: **CLI 执行。** 当信息或操作可以比 GUI 交互序列更简洁、更精确地表示为数据或代码时，Qwen-UI-Agent 倾向于使用 CLI。图 15 显示了六个反复出现的用途：从混合语料库中检索相关文档；解析机器可读记录；将多张图像整理成带标签的联系表；以编程方式转换工件；执行重复的评分计算；以及验证输出属性（如尺寸、亮度、进程状态）。这些模式共同表明，CLI 在推理之前起到搜索空间缩减器的作用，是结构化操作的高效执行通道，也是在编辑之后进行精确后置条件验证的工具。联系表示例进一步说明，CLI 可以通过将分散的视觉证据重新组织成单一比较表面来补充视觉推理，而不是取代视觉判断本身。

items.en: **Batched Execution.** Qwen-UI-Agent uses batched execution when multiple operations form a coherent local sequence and their intermediate states are sufficiently predictable to proceed without another observation. As illustrated in Figure 16, representative cases include a short GUI macro for in-page search, a 21-action dependent sequence that fills an email and proceeds to the attachment picker, and a mixed GUI–CLI sequence that manipulates an object and then verifies the resulting task state. The model terminates the batch when the next decision depends on a new screenshot, command output, dialog, or error. Batched execution therefore groups coherent local transactions rather than merely repeating similar actions.
items.zh: **批量执行。** 当多个操作形成一个连贯的局部序列，并且其中间状态足够可预测、无需再次观测即可继续时，Qwen-UI-Agent 会使用批量执行。如图 16 所示，代表性案例包括：用于页内搜索的短 GUI 宏；一个包含 21 个动作的依赖序列，用于填写电子邮件并进入附件选择器；以及一个混合 GUI–CLI 序列，用于操作对象然后验证最终任务状态。当下一步决策依赖于新的截图、命令输出、对话框或错误时，模型会终止批量执行。因此，批量执行是对连贯的局部事务进行分组，而非简单地重复相似动作。

items.capEn: Figure 17: Representative trajectory of tightly coupled GUI–CLI collaboration. The task requires Qwen-UI-Agent to achieve a score of at least 100 in a browser-based dinosaur game without using DevTools or CDP. GUI observations provide evidence for measuring jump dynamics, diagnosing failed control p

items.en: One particularly interesting trajectory asks Qwen-UI-Agent to play a browser-based dinosaur game and achieve a score of at least 100 without using browser developer tools or the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Issuing every jump as a separate model action is poorly suited to this task because obstacles continue moving during screenshot acquisition and model inference. Qwen-UI-Agent instead uses CLI to construct and iteratively refine a local controller that operates through rendered screenshots and standard keyboard events. The controller does not access the DOM or internal game state, leaving the visible GUI as its source of task state and the keyboard as its action interface.
items.zh: 一条特别有趣的轨迹要求 Qwen-UI-Agent 玩一个基于浏览器的恐龙游戏,并且在不使用浏览器开发者工具或 Chrome DevTools 协议(CDP)的情况下达到至少 100 分。将每次跳跃都作为单独的模型动作来发出,并不适合该任务,因为在截图获取和模型推理期间障碍物仍在移动。Qwen-UI-Agent 转而使用 CLI 来构建并迭代优化一个本地控制器,该控制器通过渲染后的屏幕截图和标准键盘事件运行。控制器不访问 DOM 或内部游戏状态,而是将可见 GUI 作为任务状态来源,将键盘作为动作接口。

items.en: The trajectory reveals a tightly coupled pattern of GUI–CLI composition. Successive GUI observations provide the evidence needed to measure jump dynamics, calibrate obstacle-trigger distances, and diagnose errors in jump timing and duration. CLI code converts these observations into explicit perception and control procedures. When repeated trials expose the limitations of stateless, fixed-duration taps, the model introduces explicit action state and holds the jump key until the obstacle has passed. A further challenge arises when the game switches from day to night mode. The resulting contrast inversion invalidates the initial assumption that obstacles correspond to dark pixels. After identifying this change from the rendered frames, Qwen-UI-Agent replaces fixed color thresholding with background-relative segmentation and uses obstacle geometry to handle both ground-level cacti and airborne birds.
items.zh: 该轨迹揭示了 GUI–CLI 组合中紧密耦合的模式。连续的 GUI 观察提供了测量跳跃动态、校准障碍触发距离以及诊断跳跃时机和持续时间错误所需的证据。CLI 代码将这些观察转化为显式的感知和控制程序。当重复试验暴露出无状态、固定时长敲击的局限性时,模型引入了显式动作状态,并一直按住跳跃键直到障碍通过。当游戏从白天切换到夜间模式时,又出现了新的挑战:由此产生的对比度反转使“障碍物对应深色像素”的初始假设失效。Qwen-UI-Agent 从渲染帧中识别出这一变化后,用背景相对分割取代了固定颜色阈值,并利用障碍物的几何形状同时处理地面仙人掌和空中飞鸟。

items.en: The resulting controller survives for 60 seconds while executing 50 jumps and reaches a visible last-run score of 156. This case shows that GUI and CLI provide different but interdependent functions within a single trajectory. The GUI supplies perceptual evidence and execution feedback, while CLI execution turns that evidence into repeatable perception and control procedures that do not require model inference at every game step. By repeatedly moving from GUI observation to CLI-based revision and back to GUI verification, Qwen-UI-Agent constructs an effective controller without privileged access to the application.
items.zh: 最终得到的控制器在执行 50 次跳跃的情况下存活了 60 秒,并取得了可见的上一次运行得分 156。该案例表明,GUI 和 CLI 在同一条轨迹中提供了不同但相互依赖的功能。GUI 提供感知证据和执行反馈,而 CLI 执行将这些证据转化为可重复的感知与控制程序,无需在每一步游戏时都进行模型推理。通过在 GUI 观察、基于 CLI 的修改、再回到 GUI 验证之间反复迭代,Qwen-UI-Agent 在没有对应用程序特权访问的情况下构建了一个有效的控制器。

full.sec: 4.3 Step-Level Behavioral Corrections after Action RL
full.secZh: 4.3 动作 RL 后的步骤级行为校正

items.en: Overall Performance and Behavioral Shift. We further conduct a comparative analysis of the model behaviors before and after action RL training. The primary effect of action RL is not merely an improvement in aggregate task success, but a systematic correction of erroneous action decisions at a fine-grained, step-level granularity. Beyond improving the overall task SR by more than 7%, action RL reduces the number of reasoning tokens by 21.3% while increasing the average number of interaction steps by 8.4%. These changes suggest that the updated policy performs less redundant reasoning and more frequently translates its decisions into environment-grounded actions. More importantly, the performance gains are accompanied by a clear shift in action patterns, characterized by the systematic correction of recurring action errors, which we examine in detail below.
items.zh: 总体性能与行为变化。我们进一步对 action RL 训练前后的模型行为进行了比较分析。action RL 的主要效果不仅仅是整体任务成功率的提升，更是在细粒度的步骤层面系统性地纠正错误的行为决策。除了将整体任务 SR 提升超过 7%之外，action RL 还将推理 token 数量减少了 21.3%，同时将平均交互步数增加了 8.4%。这些变化表明，更新后的策略执行了更少的冗余推理，并更频繁地将决策转化为基于环境的实际行动。更重要的是，性能提升伴随着行为模式的明显转变，其特点是系统性地纠正反复出现的动作错误，我们将在下文详细分析。

items.en: Correction of Recurring Error Patterns. As shown in Table 12, action RL consistently improves performance across all five error-pattern-specific test sets. On grounding tasks that require selecting the correct target among visually or semantically similar candidates, action RL improves SR by 6.3%. It also improves SR on Sorting and Ranking, Quantity and Multi-Target Completeness, and Premature Completion tasks by 3.8%, 4.4%, and 5.2%, respectively. The effect of action RL is particularly evident in correcting short-range action loops. On tasks involving repeated operations over multiple targets or navigation through long scrollable interfaces, action RL improves SR by 9.5%. This gain indicates a stronger ability to recognize when recent actions have failed to produce task-relevant state changes and to switch to an alternative action. Figure 18 presents a representative example in which the agent is asked to generate an invitation link in Mastodon. The model before action RL repeatedly interacts with the profile-sharing icon and eventually reaches the step limit. In contrast, the model after action RL recognizes that it is on the wrong page, explores an alternative path through Mastodon’s web interface, and reaches the correct interface for configuring the invitation link. This example highlights the central role of step-level action RL: when a short sequence of actions fails to make meaningful progress, the automatically constructed loop-breaking examples teach the policy to revise its immediate action choice rather than persist with an ineffective pattern.
items.zh: 反复出现错误模式的纠正。如表 12 所示，action RL 在全部五个针对错误模式的测试集上均持续提升了性能。在需要从视觉或语义相似候选中选择正确目标的 grounding 任务上，action RL 将 SR 提升了 6.3%。在排序与排位（Sorting and Ranking）、数量与多目标完整性（Quantity and Multi-Target Completeness）以及提前完成（Premature Completion）任务上，action RL 分别将 SR 提升了 3.8%、4.4%和 5.2%。action RL 的效果在纠正短距离动作循环方面尤为明显。在涉及对多个目标进行重复操作或需要穿越长滚动界面的任务中，action RL 将 SR 提升了 9.5%。这一提升表明，模型在识别近期动作未能产生与任务相关的状态变化并切换到替代动作方面具有更强的能力。图 18 展示了一个代表性示例，其中智能体被要求在 Mastodon 中生成邀请链接。action RL 之前的模型反复点击个人资料分享图标，最终达到步数上限。相比之下，action RL 之后的模型识别出自己处于错误页面，通过 Mastodon 网页界面探索了一条替代路径，并到达了配置邀请链接的正确界面。该示例凸显了步骤级 action RL 的核心作用：当一系列短动作未能取得有意义的进展时，自动构建的断环示例会教导策略修正其当下的动作选择，而不是固守无效的模式。

items.en: Improved Handling of Long-tail Actions. GUI action trajectories exhibit a highly imbalanced distribution. Frequent actions such as click, drag, and type account for 80.1% of primitive actions, whereas long-tail actions such as ask_user and long_press account for only 19.9%. Despite their low frequency, these actions are often critical for reaching specific application states or invoking specialized controls. Pass-N rollouts show that their reward is 16.8% lower than that of frequent actions, reflecting their limited coverage in the training data. Action RL therefore increases the proportion of long-tail action examples to about 40% in the training data, improving their reward by 6.4%. These results demonstrate that action RL can selectively strengthen low-frequency but high-impact action decisions.
items.zh: 对长尾动作的处理改进。GUI 动作轨迹呈现出高度不均衡的分布。点击、拖拽和输入等常见动作占原始动作的 80.1%，而 ask_user、long_press 等长尾动作仅占 19.9%。尽管这些动作出现频率较低，但它们往往对达到特定应用状态或调用专门控件至关重要。Pass-N rollout 显示，这些动作的奖励比常见动作低 16.8%，反映出它们在训练数据中的覆盖不足。因此，action RL 将训练数据中长尾动作示例的比例提高到约 40%，并将其奖励提升了 6.4%。这些结果表明，action RL 能够有针对性地强化低频但高影响的动作决策。

full.sec: 4.4 Trajectory-Level Behavioral Shifts after Online RL
full.secZh: 4.4 在线强化学习后的轨迹级行为变化

items.en: By carefully comparing the trajectories generated before and after online RL across different domains, we identify the emergence of three desirable behavioral patterns.
items.zh: 通过仔细比较不同领域中在线强化学习前后生成的轨迹，我们发现了三种理想行为模式的出现。

items.en: Before online RL, the policy often terminates immediately after its final state-changing action, assuming that the task has been completed without verifying the intended effect. After online RL, the policy more frequently inspects the resulting state before termination and recovers when verification reveals incomplete execution. Figure 19 illustrates a representative example. Before online RL, the policy performs a sequence of Bash operations and declares completion without checking their effects. After online RL, the policy initially follows the same Bash-based path but adds a verification step, discovers that part of the intended output was not generated, switches to an alternative approach, and ultimately completes the task successfully. Aggregate results on OSWorld show the same trend: the fraction of trajectories containing at least one verification action increases by 14.7%, accompanied by an 11.2% decrease in the false-stop rate—the fraction of self-declared successful episodes that fail the final verifier.
items.zh: 在线强化学习之前，策略通常在执行最后一个改变状态的动作后立即终止，并假设任务已完成，而不验证预期效果。在线强化学习之后，策略在终止前更频繁地检查结果状态，并在验证发现执行不完整时进行恢复。图 19 展示了一个代表性示例。在线强化学习之前，策略执行一系列 Bash 操作并声明完成，而不检查其效果。在线强化学习之后，策略最初遵循相同的基于 Bash 的路径，但增加了验证步骤，发现部分预期输出未生成，于是切换到替代方法，最终成功完成任务。OSWorld 上的汇总结果显示了同样的趋势：包含至少一个验证动作的轨迹比例增加了 14.7%，同时误停止率（即自我声明成功的回合中未通过最终验证器的比例）下降了 11.2%。

items.en: After online RL, the policy shifts from a Bash-leaning strategy to a more balanced use of Bash and GUI actions: the share of GUI actions increases by 6%, while the fraction of trajectories employing both GUI and Bash increases by 10.6%. Notably, despite the absence of an explicit objective for modality coordination, a useful pattern of cross-modal collaboration emerges: the policy uses Bash to execute state changes efficiently and the GUI to inspect their effects. Consistent with this pattern, the fraction of trajectories exhibiting an execution–verification transition—a state-changing Bash action followed by a read-only GUI inspection—increases from 40.2% to 52.4%. Figure 20 illustrates a representative example. Before online RL, the policy relies only on Bash to execute the task and, without visual information, fails to distinguish income from expenses, introducing errors into the result. After online RL, the policy executes efficiently with Bash and then opens individual receipts in the GUI for visual inspection, allowing it to distinguish the relevant entries and complete the task correctly. This cross-modal loop combines efficient execution with reliable feedback, with Bash serving as the hands and the GUI as the eyes.
items.zh: 在线强化学习之后，策略从偏向 Bash 的策略转向更均衡地使用 Bash 和 GUI 动作：GUI 动作的占比增加了 6%，同时同时使用 GUI 和 Bash 的轨迹比例增加了 10.6%。值得注意的是，尽管没有关于模态协调的明确目标，一种有用的跨模态协作模式出现了：策略使用 Bash 高效地执行状态更改，并使用 GUI 检查其效果。与此模式一致，表现出执行-验证转换（即状态更改的 Bash 动作后跟只读 GUI 检查）的轨迹比例从 40.2% 增加到 52.4%。图 20 展示了一个代表性示例。在线强化学习之前，策略仅依赖 Bash 执行任务，并且由于没有视觉信息，无法区分收入和支出，从而在结果中引入错误。在线强化学习之后，策略使用 Bash 高效执行，然后在 GUI 中打开单个收据进行视觉检查，从而能够区分相关条目并正确完成任务。这种跨模态循环将高效执行与可靠反馈相结合，Bash 充当手，GUI 充当眼睛。

items.en: Long-horizon tasks often impose additional constraints on the primary goal, including quantities, formats, ranges, and exclusions. Comparing behavior before and after online RL, we find that the policy becomes more reliable at preserving constraints introduced earlier in the instruction throughout execution. Across the two benchmarks, the fraction of tasks satisfying all instruction constraints increases by 8.6% on OSWorld and by 7.5% on BrowseComp-ZH. Figure 21 illustrates a representative BrowseComp-ZH example involving four constraints. In this case, the policy shifts from satisfying only one constraint and reaching an incorrect conclusion to retaining and jointly applying all four, leading to the correct answer.
items.zh: 长时程任务通常会对主要目标施加额外约束，包括数量、格式、范围和排除项。通过比较在线强化学习前后的行为，我们发现策略在执行过程中更可靠地保持指令早期引入的约束。在两个基准测试中，满足所有指令约束的任务比例在 OSWorld 上增加了 8.6%，在 BrowseComp-ZH 上增加了 7.5%。图 21 展示了一个涉及四个约束的 BrowseComp-ZH 代表性示例。在这种情况下，策略从仅满足一个约束并得出错误结论，转变为保留并共同应用所有四个约束，从而得出正确答案。

items.en: Recent work on GUI agents across mobile-use, browser-use, and computer-use increasingly favors native multimodal policies over prompt-only orchestration, with stronger use of self-evolving data engines, online reinforcement learning, and structured memory. The field is also moving from benchmark-only optimization toward realistic deployment concerns in terms of real-device execution, privacy, operational reliability, safety, and latency.
items.zh: 近期关于 GUI 智能体的研究横跨移动端使用、浏览器使用和计算机使用,日益偏好原生多模态策略而非仅依赖提示词的编排,并且更强调自进化数据引擎、在线强化学习和结构化记忆。该领域也从仅围绕基准的优化,转向对真实设备执行、隐私、运维可靠性、安全性和延迟等实际部署问题的关注。

items.en: Mobile Use. Recent mobile agent works increasingly move beyond screenshot-grounded action prediction toward more capable systems with memory, reflection, RL, and agentic harness. Mobile-Agent-v3.5 and UI-Venus-1.5 scale unified GUI models across diverse platforms and tasks. Step-GUI and UI-TARS-2 investigate data flywheels and multi-turn RL for improving agent capability through iterative interaction. MAI-UI explores hybrid GUI-MCP operations and device–cloud collaboration. Xiaomi-GUI-0 studies real-device closed-loop training that captures state dynamics. Existing mobile agent evaluations mainly focus on three aspects: grounding capability (e.g., ScreenSpot-Pro), interactive task completion in controlled environments (e.g., AndroidWorld), and more realistic daily-use scenarios such as MobileWorld, AndroidDaily, and RealMobile.
items.zh: 移动端使用。近期的移动智能体工作正越来越多地从基于截图的动作预测,转向具备记忆、反思、强化学习(RL)和智能体式编排框架的更强大系统。Mobile-Agent-v3.5 和 UI-Venus-1.5 在多种平台和任务上扩展统一 GUI 模型。Step-GUI 和 UI-TARS-2 研究数据飞轮和多轮强化学习,通过迭代交互提升智能体能力。MAI-UI 探索 GUI-MCP 混合操作与设备–云协同。Xiaomi-GUI-0 研究捕获状态动态的真实设备闭环训练。现有移动智能体评测主要关注三个方面:界面元素定位能力(如 ScreenSpot-Pro)、受控环境中的交互式任务完成(如 AndroidWorld),以及更真实的日常使用场景,如 MobileWorld、AndroidDaily 和 RealMobile。

items.en: Browser Use. Compared with mobile agents, browser-use agents can additionally leverage structured information such as DOM trees, accessibility trees, and browser APIs. Early research such as WebVoyager and SeeAct demonstrate the capability of multimodal LLMs to perform end-to-end web navigation by combining visual understanding with browser actions. Recent projects, such as OpenAI Operator, Google Project Mariner, and UI-TARS, further extend web agents toward autonomous interaction with complex websites and diverse digital environments. Some recent studies like WebWorld and WebEvolver also explore world-model-based approaches for web-agent. Web-agent evaluation has evolved from short-horizon webpage navigation toward realistic long-horizon workflows involving multiple websites and complex objectives.
items.zh: 浏览器使用。与移动智能体相比,浏览器使用智能体还可以利用 DOM 树、可访问性树和浏览器 API 等结构化信息。WebVoyager 和 SeeAct 等早期研究表明,多模态大语言模型能够将视觉理解与浏览器操作相结合,执行端到端的网页导航。最近的项目,如 OpenAI Operator、Google Project Mariner 和 UI-TARS,进一步将网页智能体扩展到对复杂网站和多样化数字环境的自主交互。WebWorld 和 WebEvolver 等近期研究也探索了基于世界模型的网页智能体方法。网页智能体评测已从短时程网页导航,演变为涉及多个网站和复杂目标的真实长时程工作流。

items.en: Computer Use. Computer-use agents (CUA) aim to enable general interaction with desktop environments, covering diverse software and productivity applications. Compared with mobile and web agents, CUAs face a significantly larger action space, more diverse interaction states, and longer horizon, making reliable grounding and execution verification critical. Recent efforts including UI-TARS, DART-GUI, OpenCUA, UltraCUA, EvoCUA investigate scalable GUI foundation models by leveraging multimodal pretraining, large-scale interaction data, and agentic reasoning. Recent CUA benchmarks increasingly emphasize robustness, scalability, and real-world deployment challenges. OSWorld-Verified improves evaluation reliability through stricter verification protocols and reduced ambiguity in success assessment. OSWorld-v2 further scales evaluation toward more complex, long-horizon workflows and diverse real-world computer tasks.
items.zh: 计算机使用。计算机使用智能体(CUA)旨在支持与桌面环境的通用交互,涵盖多种软件和生产力应用。与移动端和网页智能体相比,CUA 面临更大的动作空间、更多样的交互状态和更长的时间跨度,因此可靠的界面元素定位和执行验证至关重要。UI-TARS、DART-GUI、OpenCUA、UltraCUA、EvoCUA 等近期工作通过利用多模态预训练、大规模交互数据和智能体式推理,研究可扩展的 GUI 基础模型。最近的 CUA 基准越来越强调鲁棒性、可扩展性和真实部署挑战。OSWorld-Verified 通过更严格的验证协议和降低成功评估的歧义,提升了评测可靠性;OSWorld-v2 则进一步将评测扩展到更复杂、更长时程的工作流以及多样化的真实计算机任务。

items.en: We presented Qwen-UI-Agent, a real-world centric foundation GUI agent. Guided by a vision of agents that operate on real devices, maintain workflows across platforms, combine GUI interaction with CLI execution, and proactively initiate useful services, Qwen-UI-Agent integrates scalable sandbox environments with a robust real-device mobile runtime, a unified GUI+CLI action space, an agent-driven data flywheel, a training framework combining SFT, action RL, and online RL, and a harness layer for proactive service initiation and cross-platform task execution. Empirically, Qwen-UI-Agent achieves 82.1% on MobileWorld, 92.2% on MobileWorld-Real, and 97.5% on AndroidDaily. It also reaches 79.5% on OSWorld-Verified, and 40.0% on OSWorld-v2. Qwen-UI-Agent further obtains leading or competitive performance across browser use, DeepSearch, and GUI-grounding, while preserving strong general reasoning and agentic capabilities. Together, these results support a systems view of GUI agent development where models, environments, data flywheel, training, and harness are co-designed around real-world usage.
items.zh: 我们提出了 Qwen-UI-Agent，一个以真实世界为中心的基础 GUI 智能体。基于一个愿景——智能体在真实设备上运行、跨平台维持工作流、将 GUI 交互与 CLI 执行相结合，并主动发起实用服务——Qwen-UI-Agent 集成了可扩展的沙盒环境与稳健的真实设备移动运行时、统一的 GUI+CLI 动作空间、智能体驱动的数据飞轮、结合 SFT、动作 RL 和在线 RL 的训练框架，以及一个用于主动发起服务和跨平台任务执行的调度层。实验上，Qwen-UI-Agent 在 MobileWorld 上达到 82.1%，在 MobileWorld-Real 上达到 92.2%，在 AndroidDaily 上达到 97.5%；同时，它在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 79.5%，在 OSWorld-v2 上达到 40.0%。Qwen-UI-Agent 还在浏览器使用、DeepSearch 和 GUI-grounding 方面取得了领先或具有竞争力的表现，同时保持了强大的通用推理和智能体能力。总之，这些结果支持了一种 GUI 智能体开发的系统观：模型、环境、数据飞轮、训练和调度层都围绕真实世界使用进行协同设计。

items.en: First, we evaluate real-device mobile trajectories using AutoJudge rather than deterministic verifiers or manual expert examination. Deterministic state-based verification is generally infeasible on physical phones because of restricted access to the internal states of third-party applications. Meanwhile, manually adjudicating trajectories from Qwen-UI-Agent and ten baselines would require substantial expert effort and introduce inter-annotator variation. To ensure a consistent comparison, we apply the same AutoJudge protocol to all systems. On 666 examples independently examined by experts, AutoJudge achieves 92.8% exact-match accuracy. Nevertheless, its remaining errors may introduce minor uncertainty into the reported real-device results. Second, CUA and DeepSearch training at the 35B-A3B scale was still in progress when this technical report was released, so the corresponding results are not included. We plan to update the arXiv version once these results become available. Third, beyond the real-device environments described in this report, higher-fidelity synthetic environments that more closely reproduce real applications provide another path to narrowing the simulation-to-real gap. We have constructed such environments, but training with them was not yet incorporated into the reported model, so this component is not presented in the current report. We plan to open-source the environment synthesis methodology in future work. Fourth, our attempts to fully automate GUI capability development showed that current foundation models cannot yet manage the entire process reliably. Our pipeline is therefore agent-driven rather than fully autonomous and still requires considerable human oversight and intervention to monitor progress and correct errors.
items.zh: 首先，我们使用 AutoJudge 评估真实设备上的移动端轨迹，而不是确定性验证器或人工专家检查。由于物理手机上对第三方应用内部状态的访问受限，基于状态的确定性验证通常不可行。同时，人工评判来自 Qwen-UI-Agent 和十个基线的轨迹将需要大量专家努力，并引入标注者间差异。为确保一致性比较，我们对所有系统应用相同的 AutoJudge 协议。在由专家独立检查的 666 个示例中，AutoJudge 达到了 92.8%的精确匹配准确率。然而，其剩余错误可能给报告的真实设备结果带来轻微不确定性。其次，本技术报告发布时，35B-A3B 规模的 CUA 和 DeepSearch 训练仍在进行中，因此未包含相应结果。一旦这些结果可用，我们计划更新 arXiv 版本。第三，除本报告描述的真实设备环境外，更逼真地再现真实应用的高保真合成环境为缩小模拟与现实的差距提供了另一条途径。我们已构建了此类环境，但使用它们进行训练尚未纳入所报告的模型，因此当前报告未展示该部分。我们计划在未来工作中开源环境合成方法。第四，我们完全自动化 GUI 能力开发的尝试表明，当前基础模型尚不能可靠地管理整个过程。因此，我们的流程是智能体驱动的，而非完全自主，仍需要大量人工监督和干预来监控进度和纠正错误。

items.en: We discuss several directions that we believe warrant further investigation as GUI agents move toward reliable and practical real-world use.
items.zh: 我们讨论了几个方向，我们认为这些方向值得在 GUI 智能体走向可靠和实用的现实世界应用时进一步研究。

items.en: Efficient GUI Execution. GUI agents are capable of completing increasingly complex workflows directly on real devices, marking an encouraging step toward practical use. However, capability alone is not sufficient. Execution efficiency, particularly interaction latency, remains a major obstacle to practical use. Each GUI step typically requires a new observation, model inference, and environment transition, causing latency to accumulate over long trajectories. Virtual-display mechanisms across mobile and desktop systems can partially mitigate this problem by enabling background or parallel execution, but they do not remove the fundamental per-step cost of the perception–reasoning–action loop. Reducing this cost through faster inference, adaptive observation, asynchronous execution, and fewer interaction rounds therefore remains important for bringing GUI agents into practical real-world use.
items.zh: 高效 GUI 执行。GUI 智能体能够直接在真实设备上完成越来越复杂的工作流，这是迈向实际应用的可喜一步。然而，仅有能力是不够的。执行效率，尤其是交互延迟，仍是实际应用的主要障碍。每个 GUI 步骤通常需要一次新的观察、模型推理和环境转换，导致长轨迹上的延迟累积。跨移动和桌面系统的虚拟显示机制可以通过启用后台或并行执行来部分缓解该问题，但并未消除感知-推理-行动循环中每步的基本成本。因此，通过更快的推理、自适应观察、异步执行和更少的交互轮次来降低这一成本，对于将 GUI 智能体引入实际应用仍然很重要。

items.en: Harness-Assisted Long-Horizon Workflows. Our hybrid GUI+CLI action space and support for batched actions improve execution efficiency, while online RL strengthens decision making over long trajectories. A complementary direction is to further exploit the harness as a source of long-horizon support beyond the model itself. Harness-level designs for context compression, task decomposition, memory management, progress tracking, and structured tool use could improve the efficiency and reliability of long-horizon workflows from another perspective.
items.zh: 辅助框架支持的长时程工作流。我们混合的 GUI+CLI 动作空间和对批量动作的支持提高了执行效率，而在线强化学习增强了长轨迹上的决策能力。一个补充方向是进一步利用辅助框架作为模型之外的长期支持来源。用于上下文压缩、任务分解、记忆管理、进度跟踪和结构化工具使用的框架级设计可以从另一个角度提高长时程工作流的效率和可靠性。

items.en: Large-Scale Cross-Domain Online RL. Long-horizon GUI tasks make online RL costly because rollouts are slow and variable in length, while rewards are often sparse or delayed. Future work should develop more efficient and stable training strategies for these settings, while jointly training across browser-use, mobile-use, and computer-use environments to improve data efficiency and cross-domain generalization.
items.zh: 大规模跨领域在线强化学习。长时程 GUI 任务使在线强化学习成本高昂，因为展开过程缓慢且长度多变，而奖励往往稀疏或延迟。未来的工作应为这些场景开发更高效、更稳定的训练策略，同时跨浏览器使用、移动使用和计算机使用环境进行联合训练，以提高数据效率和跨领域泛化能力。

items.en: **Scalable Synthesis of High-Fidelity Environments.** Real-device environments provide the most faithful interaction dynamics, but remain expensive to scale, reset, and verify. High-fidelity synthetic environments offer a complementary path by approximating real-world application behavior in a form that can be generated and controlled at scale. Scalable synthesis of such environments is important for narrowing the simulation-to-real gap and expanding real-world-oriented training. We have constructed such environments; unfortunately, their integration into model training was not completed in time for this report. We will open-source the environment synthesis methodology in future work.
items.zh: **高保真环境的可扩展合成。** 真实设备环境提供了最真实的交互动态，但其扩展、重置和验证成本仍然很高。高保真合成环境通过以可大规模生成和控制的形式近似真实应用行为，提供了一条互补路径。此类环境的可扩展合成对于缩小仿真到真实的差距以及拓展面向真实世界的训练具有重要意义。我们已构建了此类环境，但遗憾的是，它们未能及时集成到模型训练中以纳入本报告。我们将在未来工作中开源环境合成方法。

items.en: **Safety, User Control, and Personalization.** As GUI agents gain the ability to operate across applications and devices, ensuring that their actions remain safe and under user control becomes increasingly important. In this work, we include safety-sensitive training scenarios that teach the model to invoke the call_user action and return control to the user when additional input or authorization is required. More systematic safety evaluations, safety-oriented training objectives, and interpretability-based methods for understanding and constraining agent behavior remain important directions. Personalization is equally important for improving the real-world user experience. Our proactive-service harness provides an initial exploration, but constructing useful user memories and profiles, grounding them in reliable information sources, and giving users control over what information is retained all warrant further investigation.
items.zh: **安全、用户控制与个性化。** 随着 GUI 智能体获得跨应用和跨设备操作的能力，确保其行为安全并处于用户控制之下变得越来越重要。在本工作中，我们加入了安全敏感的训练场景，教导模型在需要额外输入或授权时调用 call_user 动作并将控制权交还给用户。更系统的安全评估、面向安全的训练目标，以及基于可解释性的理解和约束智能体行为的方法，仍然是重要的研究方向。个性化对于改善真实用户体验同样重要。我们的主动服务框架提供了初步探索，但构建有用的用户记忆和用户画像、将其锚定在可靠的信息来源上，并让用户控制哪些信息被保留，这些都值得进一步研究。

full.sec: A.1 Validating AutoJudge for Real-Device Evaluation
full.secZh: A.1 在真实设备评估中验证 AutoJudge

items.en: Unlike sandbox benchmarks, real-device tasks generally cannot rely on deterministic, state-based verifiers. Third-party Apps do not expose their internal states, while task outcomes may depend on changing online content, account status, or interactions across multiple Apps. Manually reviewing every trajectory is also difficult to scale and can introduce variation between annotators. We therefore validate AutoJudge against independent human annotations before using it for large-scale real-device evaluation.
items.zh: 与沙箱基准不同，真实设备任务通常无法依赖确定性、基于状态的验证器。第三方应用不暴露其内部状态，而任务结果可能取决于不断变化的在线内容、账户状态或跨多个应用的交互。手动审查每条轨迹也难以扩展，并且可能在标注者之间引入差异。因此，我们在大规模真实设备评估中使用 AutoJudge 之前，先针对独立的人工标注对其进行验证。
